name: In-Place Overwriter
description: Updates existing records in place at their natural key location (e.g., primary key in a row store, partition key in a warehouse) rather than appending a new version. Reduces storage churn and downstream churn when only the latest state matters.
when_to_use: Only the latest value per key is needed downstream
Storage is partitioned/clustered by natural key
Append-only systems cannot deliver low-latency reads
drawbacks: Loses history unless paired with change capture
